# Jeong Jinho Portfolio

> Portfolio of Jeong Jinho (鄭 珍昊 / 정진호), a Product / UI/UX designer based in Tokyo with 20+ years of zero-to-one product work. Each case study is written as a decision record: problem, research, constraints, decision, iteration. The site is available in Japanese, English and Korean.

## Profile
- Name: Jeong Jinho (鄭 珍昊, 정진호)
- Role: UI/UX Designer at medimo (medical AI charting, B2B) since April 2026; freelance Product / BX designer as aftworks since August 2024
- Background: started in 2000 as a founding member of a student venture in Seoul; moved to Tokyo in 2010 to join LINE (then Naver Japan)
- Languages: Korean (native), Japanese (business)
- Contact: jinho@aftworks.com · 1:1 booking: https://cal.com/jeong75/30min

## Case studies
- [Jiffcy](https://www.aftworks.com/#jiffcy): Closed social app for Gen Z; designing the first minutes with zero friends (2025–, Product Designer)
- [RLWRLD](https://www.aftworks.com/#rlwrld): Brand identity built from a pixel grid for a robotics foundation-model company (2025, BX and web)
- [YOKI](https://www.aftworks.com/#yoki): Experience service for active seniors: brand, mobile web and admin, designed solo (2025, in progress)
- [PIKABON](https://www.aftworks.com/#pikabon): Brand renewal for a concert light stick brand: concept, logotype studies and guidelines (2024, adopted and in use)
- [ULINE](https://www.aftworks.com/#uline): Logo and identity for a company bringing Korean culture products to the next generation (2024, adopted)
- [Link](https://www.aftworks.com/#link): Logo and identity for a business partner company: a 30-degree flag for progress and new challenges (2024, adopted)
- [WORKSPOT](https://www.aftworks.com/#workspot): Spot-work service for hairdressers: brand, job-seeker mobile web and salon admin, designed at the PoC stage (2024)
- [ShuttlePay](https://www.aftworks.com/#shuttlepay): Savings redesign proposal for a cashless service for children: iOS screens and card design, a hiring work sample (2024, not implemented)
- [Pairs 町友](https://www.aftworks.com/#pairs): Feature proposal for the dating app Pairs: Machitomo, for meeting people nearby to hang out, a hiring work sample (2024, not implemented)
- [Taxnap](https://www.aftworks.com/#taxnap): Tax return app for freelancers (formerly swiswi): UI/UX and style guide up to the official release, designed solo (2023, launched, still running)
- [WealthPark](https://www.aftworks.com/#wealthpark): Product detail redesign for a real-estate investment service, an internal proposal designed and planned solo (2023, mostly approved, not launched)
- [WealthPark Lab](https://www.aftworks.com/#wplab): Magazine-style outward-facing media site (blog) for WealthPark, an internal proposal designed and planned solo (2023, not launched)
- [Pokke](https://www.aftworks.com/#pokke): Deals chatbot browser extension: brand, landing page, extension, store assets, designed solo (2023, launched, since closed)
- [Kyash Widget](https://www.aftworks.com/#kyash): iOS balance widget shipped from a low-priority roadmap item (2022, Product Designer)
- [Croc](https://www.aftworks.com/#croc): Cross-border marketplace (cro-c): logo, buyer screens on desktop and smartphone, and the shop admin (2022, not launched)
- [METAJOB](https://www.aftworks.com/#metajob): Brand identity and landing page for a new recruiting SaaS, designed and planned solo with two engineers (2021, BX and LP)
- [ONE](https://www.aftworks.com/#one): Receipt-buying app; snap a receipt, get ¥10. #1 overall on the Japanese App Store (2018–2019)
- [ONE PAYMENT](https://www.aftworks.com/#onepay): In-person card payments on a phone with no card reader (2017–2018, Chief Designer / Creative Director)
- [AEON.com](https://www.aftworks.com/#aeon): Corporate site for AEON.com Co., Ltd. on desktop and smartphone, designed solo (2016, launched)
- [Cookpad 料理動画](https://www.aftworks.com/#cookpadvideo): Cooking video service of Cookpad: lead design of the PC and smartphone layouts and the design guide (2014)
- [Cookpad 産地直送便](https://www.aftworks.com/#cookpad): Renewal of a farm-direct grocery e-commerce flow (2014–2015)
